title: Heavy Dense Filipino Bread Ginataang Bilo Bilo
description: A funky dense Filipino dish featuring tomato ketchup and double rise bread, this ayurvedic rajasic friendly form of ginataang bilo bilo is a unique treat. It combines the richness of coconut milk with the sweetness of bread and ketchup.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bread into small cubes and toast until lightly browned.
In a large pot, combine the coconut milk, tomato ketchup, sugar, water, and salt, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium low and add the toasted bread, tapioca pearls, and jackfruit to the pot.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes or until the tapioca pearls are cooked.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the ginataang bilo bilo warm or at room temperature.
